name: CISA Iranian APT
desc: Iranian APT exploited Log4Shell and deployed XMRig crypto mining software.

acts.d: Initial access gained through Log4Shell
PowerShell added an exclusion rule to Windows Defender and was executed on AD to obtain a list of machines on the domain
Exclusion rule allowlisted the entire c:\drive. Attackers also manually disabled Windows Defender via the GUI
mde.ps1 downloaded onto disk
mde.ps1 downloads file.zip
mde.ps1 is removed from the system
RuntimeBroker.exe can create local user accounts
Malware tests for internet connectivity by pinging 8.8.8.8
exploit payload created a scheduled task that executed RuntimeBroker.exe daily as SYSTEM
RDP used to move laterally to multiple hosts on the network
Actors used built-in Windows account - DefaultAccount
actors downloaded around 30MB of files from transfer.sh server associated with 144.76.136.153
Mimikatz was used to create a rogue domain administrator account
RDP used to move laterally to multiple hosts on the network
Logging into multiple hosts on the system, attackers manually disabled Windows Defender via the GUI
actors implanted Ngrok executables and configuration files on multiple hosts
Ngrok was used to proxy RDP connections
actors moved laterally to the domain controller via RDP
Attackers executed PowerShell commands on the AD
Attackers used PowerShell on the AD to obtain a list of all machines attached to the domain
Actors changed the password for the local administrator account on several hosts
Actors tried to dump the LSASS process with task manager
